function pm(target: string, ctx: ClassMethodDecoratorContext) {}
function fld(_: undefined, ctx: ClassFieldDecoratorContext) { return (v: string) => v.length; }
function ok(target: (x: number) => number, ctx: ClassMethodDecoratorContext) {}
class K {
  @pm #m(x: number) { return x; }
  @fld #f = 'abc';
  @pm 'q'(x: number) { return x; }
  @ok #n(x: number) { return x; }
  run() { return this.#m(1) + this.#f + this.#n(2); }
}
console.log(new K().run());
